g.title: public.review_replies
g.text: The provider's one public reply to a review. Editable and deletable by them at any time (deleting is also how a removed reply is written again); removed (status) only by an admin. Goes with its review.

g.title: public.reviews
g.text: A customer's review of a completed booking: one to five stars and their words, public at once. One per booking. Deleted only by its customer within 14 days of the booking's end; removed (status) only by an admin, under the written rules.

g.title: public.review_replies:review_id->public.reviews:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (review_id) REFERENCES reviews(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.providers
g.text: A business or host that sells Services or Experiences. One per login (owner_id is unique). Never deleted: bookings and payouts will point here, so a provider is suspended instead.
The login that owns and manages this provider. A user is a provider exactly when they own a row here. The login cannot be deleted while it owns a provider: suspend or anonymize the provider first.
The business name. Public: shown on the provider's visible listings ("Hosted by ...").
active or suspended. Only admins change it (service role); a suspended provider cannot use provider routes.
The provider's Stripe Connect Express account. Created by the server on first payout setup.
Copied from Stripe: the provider finished the onboarding form. Server-only.
Copied from Stripe: payments can be made to this provider. Server-only.
Copied from Stripe: Stripe can pay out to the provider's bank. Server-only.
The city the provider operates in, picked from active cities. Replaces the old free-text city.
One line about what the provider does. Public on their profile while they can be booked. No contact details.
About the provider, plain text. Public on their profile while they can be booked. No contact details.
The profile photo or logo (square, 512px) in the provider-photos bucket, in the provider's own folder. Public.
The profile photo's 128px copy, for small places. Public.
The cover photo (landscape, at least 1,600 x 600) in the provider-photos bucket, in the provider's own folder. Public.
The public profile's address, /providers/<slug>. Made from the business name when the provider is created; fixed.

g.title: public.review_replies:provider_id->public.providers:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
